questions.question: The marketing team presented the quarterly results ____, using clear charts and simple language.
questions.zh: 空格修飾動詞 presented，必須用副詞 clearly。clear 是形容詞、clarity 是名詞，都不能修飾動詞；clearer 是比較級，但句中沒有任何比較對象。
questions.tip: 空格在動詞後、逗號前，先判斷缺的是副詞。

questions.question: Ms. Tanaka ____ for the company since she graduated from college in 2015.
questions.zh: since 加上過去時間點（2015 年畢業）表示動作從過去持續到現在，須用現在完成式 has worked。worked 是過去式，無法表達「持續至今」；works 是現在簡單式，不能與 since 子句搭配。
questions.tip: since + 過去時間點 → 現在完成式。

questions.question: All expense reports must ____ by the department manager before reimbursement.
questions.zh: 主詞 expense reports 是「被批准」的對象，情態動詞 must 之後要用 be + 過去分詞構成被動語態。approve 與 have approved 都是主動；approving 是進行式形式，前面不能只接 must。
questions.tip: 主詞是動作的接受者，情態動詞後用 be + p.p.。

questions.question: Please submit your travel documents ____ to the departure date so that the visa can be processed in time.
questions.zh: prior to 是固定片語，意思是「在……之前」，後面直接接名詞。before 本身就是介系詞，不能再加 to；ahead 要搭配 of 才表示「在……之前」；earlier 不與 to 連用。
questions.tip: ____ to + 名詞 → prior to（= before）。

questions.question: ____ the new software was more expensive than expected, it reduced processing time by nearly 40 percent.
questions.zh: 前句說軟體比預期貴、後句說卻省下近四成處理時間，兩者是讓步對比，用 Although。Because 表因果，語意相反；Therefore 是副詞，不能連接兩個子句；Unless 表否定條件。
questions.tip: 前後語意相反 → Although / Even though。

questions.question: The consultant ____ contract was renewed last week has proposed a new pricing model.
questions.zh: 空格後是名詞 contract，表示「顧問的合約」，需要所有格關係代名詞 whose。who 與 whom 指人但分別當主格、受格；which 指物，都不能接名詞表所屬。
questions.tip: 關係代名詞後直接接名詞 → whose。

questions.question: This year's ad campaign was ____ than last year's, generating twice as many leads.
questions.zh: 句中出現 than，前後必須是比較級；successful 是多音節形容詞，比較級用 more successful。most successful 是最高級、as successful 需搭配 as 構成原級比較，皆與 than 不合。
questions.tip: 看到 than 就要找比較級。

questions.question: The board decided to ____ the merger until the legal review is complete.
questions.zh: 句意為「延後併購案直到法務審查完成」，put off 就是延期。put on 是穿上或舉辦、put up 是搭建或提供住宿、put away 是收納，都不合 until 子句的語意。
questions.tip: until + 完成時機 → 動作是「延後」→ put off。

questions.question: The success of the product launch depended largely on the ____ of the sales team.
questions.zh: the ____ of 的結構中空格必須是名詞，dedication 意為「投入、奉獻」。dedicate 是動詞、dedicated 是形容詞或過去分詞、dedicating 是動名詞，都無法當 the 的中心名詞。
questions.tip: the + ____ + of → 填名詞。

questions.question: By the end of next quarter, the company ____ three new branches in Southeast Asia.
questions.zh: By the end of + 未來時間點，表示在該時點之前「已經完成」，須用未來完成式 will have opened。will open 只表未來的動作，未強調完成；opened 是過去式，與 next quarter 衝突。
questions.tip: By + 未來時間 → will have + p.p.。

questions.question: Employees were ____ to learn that the company would cover all certification fees.
questions.zh: 主詞是人（employees），描述人「感到高興」用過去分詞 pleased。pleasing 意為「令人愉快的」，主詞應是事物；please 是原形動詞、pleasure 是名詞，都不能放在 be 動詞後當補語。
questions.tip: 人感到情緒 → -ed 形容詞；事物令人… → -ing 形容詞。

questions.question: You may work from home ____ your supervisor approves the request in advance.
questions.zh: 後句是允許居家工作的前提條件，as long as 意為「只要」，後面接完整子句。unless 是「除非」，語意相反；despite 與 in case of 都是介系詞，只能接名詞，不能接 your supervisor approves 這種子句。
questions.tip: 空格後是完整子句且表「只要」→ as long as。

questions.question: The new accounting system updates ____ automatically every night at midnight.
questions.zh: 主詞 system 是單數，動作 updates 又回到主詞本身，要用反身代名詞 itself。its 是所有格，不能當動詞的受詞；themselves 是複數；it 無法表達「自我更新」的意思。
questions.tip: 主詞與受詞是同一人／物 → 反身代名詞。

questions.question: Because the shipment was delayed, we have received ____ information about the new delivery date.
questions.zh: information 是不可數名詞，只能用 little 或 much 修飾；句中說「因為延誤，所以幾乎沒收到資訊」，用 little。few、a few、many 都只能修飾可數複數名詞。
questions.tip: information / advice / equipment 不可數 → little / much。

questions.question: The IT department recommends ____ the server during non-business hours.
questions.zh: recommend 後接動名詞，recommend doing something 表示「建議做某事」。recommend 不接 to + 原形動詞，原形 upgrade 與過去分詞 upgraded 也都不合。
questions.tip: recommend / suggest / avoid / consider 後面接 V-ing。

questions.question: The train ____ have been delayed; it is already 40 minutes behind schedule.
questions.zh: 後句「已經誤點 40 分鐘」是明確證據，對過去事實做肯定推測用 must have + p.p.（一定已經……）。should have p.p. 表「早該做而沒做」、could have p.p. 表「本來可以」、would have p.p. 表與過去事實相反的假設結果。
questions.tip: 有明確證據的過去推測 → must have + p.p.。

questions.question: The conference room ____ the training session will be held can seat up to 60 people.
questions.zh: 先行詞是地點 conference room，而子句 the training session will be held 結構已完整、只缺地方副詞，因此用關係副詞 where（= in which）。which 與 that 需在子句中當主詞或受詞；who 只能指人。
questions.tip: 先行詞是地點且子句完整 → where / in which。

questions.question: ____ the client request a change, the project manager will issue a revised timeline.
questions.zh: 條件句省略 if 時要倒裝，句型為 Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞，等於 If the client should request a change（萬一客戶要求變更）。Would、Might、Could 不能用來引導這種倒裝條件句。
questions.tip: 省略 if 的條件句 → Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

questions.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Subject: Printing Room Relocation

The printing room on the third floor will move to the second floor on November 14. [1] During the move, the copiers on the second floor will stay available, although printing may take longer than usual.

The old room will then be converted into a small meeting space. Employees who keep personal items in the printing room should remove them by November 12; [2], anything left behind will be discarded.

A map showing the new location [3] in the elevator lobby on Monday. We appreciate your patience while the work is being done.

Facilities Management
questions.question: 第 1 題：選擇最適合 [1] 的選項
options: The work is expected to take approximately two days.
The second floor is also home to the accounting department.
Please return your old security badges to reception.
The company will hire two additional maintenance workers.
questions.zh: 下一句以 During the move 開頭，前面必須先說明「搬遷這件事會發生、大約多久」，選項 A 指出工程約需兩天，銜接最順。選項 B 只是介紹樓層單位、C 是門禁卡、D 是招募人力，都與搬遷時程無關。
questions.tip: 插入句要能承接下一句的 During the move。

questions.tip: 「要求 + 否則後果」→ otherwise。

questions.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL RESIDENTS — Water System Maintenance

The building's water supply will be shut off on Tuesday, March 4, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. so that the maintenance crew can replace old pipes in the basement. [1]

Residents are advised to store enough water for drinking and cooking the night before. [2] the repair is finished, the water may appear slightly cloudy for a few hours; this is normal and safe.

We apologize for the inconvenience. If you have any questions, please contact the management office [3] 555-0142.
questions.question: 第 1 題：選擇最適合 [1] 的選項
options: We expect the work to be completed by 3:00 p.m., and service will resume shortly afterward.
The basement will be closed to all residents for the rest of the month.
Please pay your monthly maintenance fee at the management office.
The elevator will be inspected on the same day.
questions.zh: 前句已說明停水時間為 9:00 到 15:00，選項 A 補上「預計 15:00 前完工、之後恢復供水」，與停水公告的主題一致。其餘選項談地下室整月封閉、管理費、電梯檢查，都是公告未提到的另一件事。
questions.tip: 插入句須延續停水與復水的時間資訊。

questions.passage:

We apologize for the inconvenience. If you have any questions, please contact the management office [3] 555-0142.
questions.question: 第 2 題：選擇最適合 [2] 的選項
questions.zh: 句意為「修復完成後，水可能會略微混濁幾個小時」，Once 引導時間副詞子句，表示「一旦……就」。Although 表讓步、Unless 表否定條件，語意不通；Despite 是介系詞，不能接 the repair is finished 這種完整子句。
questions.tip: 空格後是完整子句且表「一旦……就」→ Once。

questions.zh: 電話號碼前用介系詞 at，contact someone at 555-0142 是固定用法。on 用於日期或星期、in 用於月份或空間範圍、by 表「經由某種方式」，都不接電話號碼。
questions.tip: 電話號碼前用 at。

questions.passage:
From: Daniel Reyes <d.reyes@northbridge-logistics.com>
To: Priya Nair <p.nair@northbridge-logistics.com>
Date: May 6
Subject: Re: Warehouse audit — action items

Hi Priya,

Thanks for sending the audit summary yesterday. I have reviewed the three issues the inspectors raised, and I agree that the damaged shelving on the loading dock is the most urgent. I have asked Maintenance to order replacement units, and they expect delivery within ten days.

The second issue — inaccurate inventory counts — will take longer. Rather than retrain the whole team at once, I would like to run a two-hour refresher session for the night shift first and measure the error rate for a month before deciding whether to extend it to the day shift.

As for the missing barcode scanners, I found two in the IT storage room. Please confirm whether the third one is still needed before I submit a purchase request.

Could we meet on Friday at 2 p.m. to finalize the plan? I am away at a supplier site on Thursday.

Best,
Daniel
questions.question: According to Daniel, which problem is the most urgent?
options: Damaged shelving on the loading dock
questions.zh: 第一段明確寫出 "I agree that the damaged shelving on the loading dock is the most urgent"，並已請維修部門訂購新品。庫存數量不準是「第二個問題」、條碼掃描器排在最後，供應商延遲交貨信中并未提及。
questions.tip: the most urgent 是定位關鍵字，答案就在同一句。

Starting with the night shift and tracking results for a month

questions.tip: Rather than 之後是被否定的做法，答案在前半句。

questions.passage:
GRANDVIEW FITNESS CENTER — SUMMER MEMBERSHIP PROMOTION

Join between June 1 and June 30 and pay no enrollment fee (regularly $75). Members who sign up for a 12-month plan also receive two free personal training sessions and unlimited access to all group classes, including yoga, spinning, and boxing.

Facilities include a 25-meter indoor pool, a sauna, and a full weight room. The pool is closed for resurfacing from July 8 to July 15; during this period, members may use the pool at our Riverside location at no extra cost by showing their membership card.

Hours: Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 8 a.m.–8 p.m. The weight room closes 30 minutes before the center.

To register, visit the front desk or call 555-0177. Cancellation requires 30 days' written notice.
questions.question: What is offered specifically to members who choose a 12-month plan?
options: A guest pass for a friend
questions.zh: 第一段寫 "Members who sign up for a 12-month plan also receive two free personal training sessions"，這是 12 個月方案專屬。免報名費（no enrollment fee）是 6 月入會的所有人都有，三溫暖屬一般設施，免費招待券廣告中沒提。
questions.tip: also receive 之後列出方案專屬優惠。

questions.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — MEMO
To: All Department Managers
From: Human Resources
Re: Professional development budget, second half of the year

Each department has a training budget of $2,400 for July through December. Courses must be booked at least two weeks before the start date, and every request requires the department manager's signature. Employees may attend one external course per quarter.

Courses costing more than $600 per person must also be approved by the division director. Requests for courses held in December will not be accepted after November 15, because the finance office closes its accounts early.

DOCUMENT 2 — COURSE LIST
Course | Fee per person | Date
Business Writing Workshop | $450 | August 12
Advanced Data Analysis | $780 | September 9
Customer Service Excellence | $320 | October 21
Project Management Essentials | $950 | November 4
Negotiation Skills | $600 | December 3
questions.question: Which course requires approval from both the department manager and the division director?
questions.zh: 備忘錄規定「每個人費用超過 $600 的課程」還須副總（division director）核准，對照課程表只有 Advanced Data Analysis（$780）與 Project Management Essentials（$950）超過 600 美元，選項中只有前者。Negotiation Skills 剛好 $600，未「超過」，是陷阱。
questions.tip: more than $600 不含剛好 $600，須嚴格比對金額。

questions.question: What is the latest date on which a request for the Negotiation Skills course can be submitted?
questions.zh: Negotiation Skills 在 12 月 3 日上課。備忘錄有兩項限制：須於開課前兩週報名（即 11 月 19 日前），且 12 月課程的申請在 11 月 15 日之後不受理。兩者取較早者，故最晚 11 月 15 日。11 月 19 日只符合兩週規定，漏看財務結帳期限。
questions.tip: 兩條期限同時存在時，取較早的那一天。

questions.question: A department sends two employees to Project Management Essentials. How much of that department's training budget will remain?
questions.zh: 部門預算為 $2,400（文件一），Project Management Essentials 每人 $950（文件二），兩人共 $1,900，剩餘 $2,400 − $1,900 = $500。$1,900 是已花費金額、$950 是單人費用、$1,450 是只扣一人的算法。
questions.tip: 先算總花費，再用預算相減；注意題目問的是 remain。
